sources.title: A tiny biped robot you can teach new tricks - Pollen Robotics
sources.snippet: Microduck is a 25 cm biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, LiDAR and a grasping beak. Playable out of the box, and its open-source stack lets you train new behaviours in simulation and run them on the robot. Pre-order at $399.

sources.title: Microduck DIY: build, mod and 3D print the open-source duck robot
sources.snippet: Microduck is an open-source robot, not a sealed product. The Apache-2.0 repositories publish the robot's software, the SDK and the reinforcement-learning environments, which means the DIY path is real: modify it, print for it, train for it, and understand every part of it.
